title: Account Executive, Affiliate Marketing
description:
Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing  

Location: UK or Germany  

The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events.  

The Role:  

As an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.

title: Socia Media TikTok Creator (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns
 Wir möchten mit natürlichen Bienenprodukten das körperliche Wohlbefinden der Menschen und ihre Gesundheit unterstützen. Wir sind ein aufstrebendes Wachstumsunternehmen im Kosmetik- und Beauty-Segment des E-Commerce. Unsere Produkte stehen für natürliche Inhaltsstoffe mit hochwirksamer Wirkung – kombiniert mit den Kräften von Bienenprodukten wie Honig, Propolis oder Gelée Royale.
 Unsere Mission
 Wir von bedrop wollen die Kraft der Bienenprodukte wieder zurück ins Bewusstsein der Menschen bringen. Und für diese Mission benötigen wir Deine Unterstützung!
 Stellenbeschreibung
Werde unser kreativer und motivierter Social Media Manager Tiktok (m/w/) und bringe unsere Marke auf das nächste Level! In dieser dynamischen Rolle bist du verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Optimierung innovativer Content-Strategien speziell für TikTok. Du nutzt dein Gespür für Trends, um authentische und ansprechende Inhalte zu kreieren, die unsere Zielgruppe begeistern und unsere Markenbekanntheit steigern. Mit deinem Engagement trägst du dazu bei, unsere digitale Präsenz zu stärken und eine lebendige Community aufzubauen. Wenn du leidenschaftlich im Bereich Social Media Marketing bist und Spaß daran hast, kreative Kampagnen zu gestalten, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
 Aufgaben
 Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer TikTok-Content-Strategien, die auf aktuelle Trends reagieren und unsere Markenbotschaft effektiv kommunizieren
 Erstellung, Bearbeitung und Veröffentlichung von kurzen, ansprechenden Videos, die unsere Zielgruppe begeistern
 Überwachung der Performance der TikTok-Kampagnen durch Analyse relevanter Kennzahlen (z.B. Views, Engagement, Follower-Wachstum)
 Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing-Team zur Integration von Social Media Marketing in umfassende Kampagnen
 Nutzung von SEO-Techniken zur Optimierung der Inhalte für maximale Sichtbarkeit innerhalb der Plattform

title: Security Architect
description:
Intelance is appointing a Security Architect as a contract associate for the definition phase of a major UK enterprise technology programme. You will provide a focused security review of the proposed integration approach and work with Intelance's Chief Enterprise Architect, Lead Integration Architect and Oracle Technical Architect. The work will set the security requirements for how systems, APIs, files, identities and sensitive data connect. The expected commitment is about 5 days across an 8 to 10 week period. Delivery will be mainly remote, with limited planned travel where needed.
 Tasks
 Review the current security controls affecting integrations, Oracle, bespoke applications and external connections.
 Define security requirements for APIs, messaging, file transfer and service accounts.
 Set identity, access, authentication, authorisation and privileged access requirements.
 Define encryption, key and secret management requirements.
 Define logging, monitoring, alerting and audit requirements.
 Review network boundaries and data flows for security risks.
 Identify the controls required before a connection can go live.
 Provide security questions and scoring criteria for platform and supplier selection.
 Rank security risks and recommend practical treatment.
 Produce a concise security architecture review and requirements set.
 Requirements
 At least 8 years of security architecture experience.
 Strong recent experience designing security for APIs and enterprise integrations.
 Strong knowledge of identity and access, service accounts, secrets, encryption, API gateways, network separation, logging and monitoring.
 Experience working across legacy systems and modern integration platforms.
 Able to run threat modelling and turn risks into clear technical requirements.
 Able to explain security decisions clearly to non technical leaders.
 Clear written and spoken English.
 Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the United Kingdom.
 Available for abo…

title: Oracle Technical Architect
description:
Intelance is appointing an Oracle Technical Architect as a contract associate for the definition phase of a major UK enterprise technology programme. You will work with Intelance's Chief Enterprise Architect and Lead Integration Architect to confirm how the Oracle estate should support a staged integration programme. The current environment includes Oracle Database 19c, IBM AIX and Oracle Data Guard. This is a focused architecture and assurance role. The expected commitment is about 10 days across an 8 to 10 week period. Delivery will be mainly remote, with limited planned travel where needed.
 Tasks
 Verify the current Oracle database, infrastructure, resilience and integration position.
 Confirm the planned Oracle 19c, IBM AIX and Oracle Data Guard changes and the dependencies they create.
 Define which data and business rules must remain within Oracle.
 Define the safe boundary between Oracle and the future integration platform.
 Review existing direct connections and identify the highest risk dependencies.
 Set requirements for availability, backup, recovery, performance, monitoring and support.
 Assess whether planned Oracle and infrastructure investments remain suitable.
 Provide Oracle requirements for platform and supplier selection.
 Estimate specialist effort, dependencies, risks and likely delivery stages.
 Produce clear technical findings and practical recommendations.
 Requirements
 At least 10 years working with enterprise Oracle estates.
 Strong recent architecture experience with Oracle Database 19c.
 Strong hands on or design experience with IBM AIX and Oracle Data Guard.
 Experience with highly available, business critical Oracle environments.
 Experience reviewing Oracle integrations, interfaces, batch jobs, files and database links.
 Strong understanding of backup, recovery, patching, performance, resilience and security.
 Able to separate verified facts from assumptions and identify what needs further testing.
 Able to explain Oracle decisions…
